step1_restricted_build.description: build_hollow_products.py with searched frame set restricted to NAC frames with 60<=incidence<=75 deg at all latitudes (corrected positions). Coverage nimg/bestpx and completeness pairs use only those frames; detections keep their positions. Truncated-binomial fit conditioned on hollows with >=1 detection in the restricted frames (2848 of 5543) to avoid violating the >=1-detection truncation.
step1_restricted_build.note_restricted_binc: b_inc weakly identified over the narrow 60-75 deg range (0.055); completeness grid built at fixed inc=60.

step2_binc_by_stage.description: Per-frame detection function fitted separately on canonical hollows whose 0.8-release Stage is 1 (halo-bearing) vs >=2 (degraded/relief-only), full frame set. Match by thumbnail tag (854) or position <=300 m in release coordinates (1617); 2471 of 6667 non-trace canonical hollows labeled. Bootstrap over hollows, 600 reps, seed 20260911.

step3_latitude_residual.description: Size-marginalized coverage x completeness null (net_pipeline.py logic, north) rebuilt from the restricted grids; observed/null field fraction per 10-deg band using only fields with >=1 non-trace member hollow detected in a 60-75 deg frame (353 of 942 north fields). Ratio CI95 by bootstrap over observed fields, 2000 reps.

verdict_illumination_bias: The illumination/incidence bias is REAL in the detection function but does NOT drive the latitude distribution of fields. Step 2: relief-only (Stage>=2) hollows have b_inc=+0.43 [0.30,0.58] versus b_inc=-0.12 [-0.19,-0.06] for halo-bearing (Stage 1); the difference 0.55 [0.39,0.73] excludes zero (0/600 bootstraps<=0), and the v2 completeness model's b_inc=-0.10 matches Stage 1 only, missing the degraded population entirely. Step 3: however, restricting the searched set to 60-75 deg frames at ALL latitudes does not flatten the mid-latitude excess -- it preserves and sharpens it (ratio 40-60N = 2.4/3.1, Spearman rho=0.91 vs v2 panel-d, p=0.002). The equatorial deficit deepens (ratio 0.26/0.46; density 4.3 vs 70.6 per 1e6 km2 at 50-60N) even though the equator is well imaged at 60-75 deg (1837 frames, 3.98e6 km2 searched at 0-10N). The equatorial deficit and the 40-60N excess are therefore NOT incidence artifacts; they are consistent with a real spatial (geological-province) signal. Net: the catalogue's unmodeled illumination sensitivity for degraded hollows is confirmed, but it is not the explanation for the latitude residual.
